segments.name: Live streaming
segments.description: Operates its own live streaming platforms in the PRC for users and broadcasters.
segments.evidence: Scienjoy Inc., through its subsidiaries and variable interest entities, is principally engaged in operating its own live streaming platforms in the PRC.

revenueModel.text: Users pay by purchasing virtual currency on the platforms, which they spend on virtual gifts for broadcasters.
revenueModel.evidence: the number of paying users, which refers to the number of users that has purchased virtual currencies on our platforms at least once in a given period.
